title: Route 54 Watersports (Fenwick Island Delaware)
specs: Largest riding area in town for waverunners
Fishing charters include common catches: Flounder, Bluefish, Tog, Croaker, Spot
Drivers must be 16 with a Government Issued ID
Drivers age 16/17 must be signed off by a parent/guardian

includes: Captain (US Coast guard Master Captain with MD Guide License) and Mate for fishing charters
Fishing gear, bait, and fuel included in fishing charters
gap: Duration of fishing charters not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests can rent Yamaha EX and VX Waverunners for guided rides in the largest riding area in town. They can also book fishing charters on a 31 ft Center Console Ocean Master boat or rent pontoon boats for a day in Assawomen Bay. Parasailing is not available.
extraNote: Waverunner cancellations must be made 24 hours before scheduled time · Fishing charter cancellations must be made 48 hours before scheduled departure · Pontoon boat cancellations must be made 24 hours before scheduled time · No cancellations permitted on holidays or holiday weekends
